story: Dan and Aiko visit Dan's uncle at his house. They realize they have a problem with the door key. Dan shows Aiko the wrong key. They go into the house to find a better way to enter.
title: The Wrong Key
setting: Outside and inside a small house with a garden.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: A young boy with brown hair and a blue t-shirt.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: A young girl with long black hair and a red sweater.

characters.name: Uncle
characters.look: A tall man with glasses and a green shirt.

sentences.en: Dan and Aiko visit their uncle today.
sentences.zh: Dan和Aiko今天去拜访他们的叔叔。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko stand in front of a small house with their uncle.

sentences.en: The sun is high above the trees.
sentences.scene_prompt: The bright sun is shining high above green trees.

sentences.en: Dan wants to buy a new bag.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan points to a small bag in a shop window.

sentences.en: He wears a pair of blue jeans.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一条蓝色牛仔裤。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan is wearing blue jeans and a blue t-shirt.

sentences.en: Aiko has a short walk to the door.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko walks a short distance toward the wooden door.

sentences.en: They have a problem with the door.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko look at a locked wooden door.

sentences.en: Dan shows Aiko a small metal key.
sentences.zh: Dan给Aiko看一把小小的金属钥匙。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan holds up a small silver key for Aiko to see.

sentences.en: This is the wrong key for him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这是错误的钥匙。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan looks sad while holding the small key near the lock.

sentences.en: He must speak to his uncle now.
sentences.zh: 他现在必须和他的叔叔说话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan looks at his uncle and opens his mouth to speak.

sentences.en: They go into the warm house together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起进入温暖的房子里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko walk into the open door of the house.

sentences.en: A better day is starting for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，更好的一天开始了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko smile inside the bright house.
